attempts.rationale: The buffer overflow occurs because `memcpy` copies up to `s` bytes where `s` may exceed the actual available memory due to integer underflow when computing `(size_t)MZ_MIN(pZip->m_archive_size - file_ofs, n)`. If `file_ofs` exceeds `pZip->m_archive_size`, then `pZip->m_archive_size - file_ofs` becomes negative, casting to `size_t` yields a very large value, leading to out-of-bounds read. The fix adds a bounds check before calling `memcpy`.
